ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest4498E3: To get started on getting your ultimate &eApotheosis&r gear, you'll need to fight monsters and explore the world for &bGems&r!
&bGems&r are crystals that provide a powerful bonuses when applied to &bAffix&r items.
To apply a &bGem&r to an item, you must combine it with the item in a &aSmithing Table&r. The item must have an open &aGem Socket&r for this to work.
Gems give different bonuses when slotted in different item types, and can be upgraded in the &aGem Cutting Table&r.
&cUnique Gems&r can only be socketed once per item, while most other gems can be socketed multiple times for stacking bonuses.
There are a variety of &eApotheosis&r &bGems&r, which you can get by killing mobs and bosses.
&bGems&r can also be crushed by an anvil to create &aGem Dust&r.
You can use &aGem Dust&r for a variety of things, but the first thing you'll want to make is a &aSalvaging Table&r!
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest464AED: Before we dive into &eApotheosis&r, we need to cover what an &bAffix&r is!
An &bAffix&r is the driving force behind all &eApotheosis&r gear. Each &bAffix&r is very similar to an enchantment, providing a bonus to the item it is attached to.

&bAffix&r items can be found when exploiring the world and their effects vary based on the item's rarity. They are more commonly dropped from &eApotheosis&r boss monsters which can be found in underground caves or have a chance to randomly appear during the night.
There are a few different types of &bAffixes&r, each affecting a specific part of the item such as: Stats, Effects, Durability, and &bGem Sockets&r, which will be covered in the &bGems&r section.

ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest4F6F0F: Takes in ember energy to charge Mantle Jars and Cartridges
Mantle cartridge is used in offhand to power dawnstone gear
Mantle Jar can be anywhere in player inventory
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest548E75: The &aModifier Workbench&r allows modifiers on equipment to be heavily tweaked and flexible.
Everything from hiding modifiers, to adjusting how they're ordered, to breaking down enchanted books into compatible modifiers, and more!

ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest57025B: These swords can be made in &6Midgard&f and are stronger than other weapons available at that stage of progression, but come with a relatively harder crafting cost.

ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest61ECB6: Dawnstone gear is unbreakable but uses ember energy instead

ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest6585D0: Drawing on the power of a defeated Watcher, an Occult Gem can be bound to a Beholder to shift perspective to that location any time the Occult Gem is used.
This power does not function between &6Realms&f.
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest675BB2: Combined with the magical energy of the Warden, &3Sculkshelves&r provide more power, and more insight.

Each pedestal must contain an Aspectus and if incorrect the recipe will fail
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest69B841: Can harvest nuggets from the seeds and seeds can be levelled up when provided with ember via the Injector

ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest70D5BE: Got a lot of random enchanted gear? Using a &dTome of Scrapping&r, you can break it down and extract some of the enchantments from it.
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest722901: To upgrade your &cHellshelves&r, you have two options!
The cheaper option is to create &eGlowing Hellshelves&r. These provide less &aEterna&r and &5Arcana&r overall, as well as increasing your &cQuanta&r.

If you are looking to add more &aEterna&r, creating a &cBlazing Hellshelf&r is also another option. These provide a nice &aEterna&r boost, but increases your &cQuanta&r by 10%% and removes an &3Enchanting Clue&r.
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest7244D5: The &bSeashelf of Aquatic Filtration&r can be loaded with up to six enchanted books, and will block those enchantments from showing up again.
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest73C25D: When equipped, the &aTinker's Lens&r displays extra information about your Ember Network and Ember Machinery
The &2Tinker's Hammer&r primarily functions as this mod's hammer which can be used to pipes and link power to your machines, but it can also be used to craft plates early on.
The &dDials&r are useful little tools that display information about any &eEmbers&r machine, fluid tank, or item storage attached to their relevant couterpart.
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest74AB81: Combined with the magical energy of the Warden, &3Sculkshelves&r provide more power, and more insight.
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest75E1B4: The initial entry point into working hot materials, the &2Melter&r requires a &3Seared Heater&r or &3Tank&r under it to function, fueled by burning solids or hot liquids like lava.
Once there's fluid in the &2Melter&r, it can be extracted with a &3Seared Faucet&r to pour the liquid into a &aCasting Table&r or &aBasin&r to let the hot material cool off into a desired shape.
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest77AD5D: Items can be moved through your machines using any type of pipe or item transport method.
The &aItem Extractor&r from &eEmbers&r pulls items out from a connected storage, to the nearest available inventory when powered by &credstone&r.

ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest7D943E: Ashen Goggles allows you to see machine information
Cloak is upgradeable by adding inflictor gems which reduce a particular damage type by 1/3
Inflictor gems can be assigned a damage type by having that item in your hand whenever you take damage
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest7E6312: Now that metallurgy is unlocked, metallic tool parts can be created to either make new tools or upgrade existing ones.
With metallurgy, more options become available for fashion and protection alike.
Plating templates are crafted using stone in the &2Part Builder&r, and then used to craft a cast for making proper Plating.
Copper or Leather &bMaille&r can be crafted with the &2Part Builder&r and then either used to craft armor or create a cast for advanced &bMaille&r types.
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest7E685E: The &aSalvaging Table&r is used to break down affix items into their corresponding rarity materials:
The &aSalvaging Table&r can be automated by sending items in from the top or sides, and extracting them from the bottom of the table. Don't lose any items!
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest7E88C7: The &6Augmenting Table&r is an end-game crafting station used to augment the individual &bAffixes&r of an item.
Firstly, it can upgrade an existing &bAffix&r costing two &6Sigils of Enhancement&r to upgrade the &bAffix&r by 25%%. How much of a boost this provides varies per &bAffix&r.
Secondly, it can reroll an &bAffix&r costing one &6Sigil of Enhancement&r to swap out a selected &bAffix&r for another of the same type. The alternative options will be shown on the left.

The &6Augmenting Table&r has two input slots. The upper slot holds the item you wish to &dAugment&r, which must be an &bAffix&r item. The lower slot holds the &6Sigils of Enhancement&r used for &dAugmenting&r.
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.quest7F11DA: These swords can be made in &6Helheim&f and are stronger than other weapons available at that stage of progression, but come with a relatively harder crafting cost.
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.questA7C1FE: &eApotheosis&r overhauls the vanilla enchanting system with three new values, allowing for high-level enchants with upgradable progression. You will want to manage these values as you progress through upgrading your enchanting setup:
&aEterna&r: The power of the enchanting table, capped based on the tier of your bookshelves. This stat determines the maximum level of enchants.
&cQuanta&r: The chaos inherent when enchanting at higher power. This determines the randomness of enchants.
&dArcana&r: The overall quality and quantity of the enchantments. This determines the rarity of enchants, as well as how many enchants are applied per use.
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.questE0BB49: &6Treasure Enchantments&r are special enchants that can only be found in loot, or from trading with villagers. That is, unless you have a &3Deepshelf of Arcane Treasures&r...
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.questEE35D6: The most useful item for any enchanting setup; it acts as a storage chest for enchantments, and allows you to pick and choose which
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.questF66736: &eEmbers: Rekindled&r is a dwarven-style mod that allows you to forge metals using the magical properties of Ember Crystals
Carminite is the most basic starting resource for the &eEmbers&r mod.
The &aAncient Codex&r is an interactive guidebook for this mod.
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.questF6BD6F: Place the base and the stamper with a one-block gap, similar to create presser
A bin underneath will auto-accept pressed items, otherwise they will stay on top of the block and can be vaccummed like other items
ftbquests.chapter.gearing_up.questFA528E: These robes can grant bursts of flight after staying for a while in shaded areas.
The &dDreadbow&f fires a volley of darkness-imbued arrows onto its target location.

ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest111: &eArs Nouveau&r is a mod dedicated to the magic in the world! And of course with magic, you get to cast &dSpells&r!
It also comes with some basic spell &2Glyphs&r already learned to help you craft your first spell!"
To do that, you'll need to learn how to make the
. This allows you to create, store, and cast
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest133: Once you've gathered a &aSpell Scroll&r, we can inscribe it into our spell tome using the &aInscription Table&r.

In the interface of the table, you can insert the Spell Tome you wish to inscribe your spell scrolls into. You can then add a Spell Scroll to the empty slot on the left side underneath the tome, then click on the icon above it to inscribe the spell.
Each spell tome can hold up to a different amount of spells overall, with our &aFlimsy Journal&r only holding 5. It might be a good idea to upgrade that soon!
You can also remove spells inscribed in the tome by selecting the spell in the interface, then clicking on the Spell Scroll on the right side to take it out.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest138: Ars Nouveau allows you to perform &drituals&r to summon mobs, build floating islands, and much more!

To make your first Ritual, you'll need to craft a &3Ritual Brazier&r and one of the many different types of &dRitual Tablets&r that you'd like to perform. Place the Brazier down and then use the tablet for the ritual you'd like, then right click again with an empty hand to perform the ritual.
Most rituals will need &dSource&r to activate, so make sure to have a jar nearby!

Rituals can also be &aaugmented&r using certain items to empower them. This is done by first using the &3Ritual Tablet&r on it first, then by using the items on the Brazier one at a time to fulfill the augment needs. Once finished, you can right click with an empty hand to activate the ritual.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest13D: You can craft &aArchwood Saplings&f early on using Malum, or you can randomly find them in other &6Realms&f.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest16D: The &bStable Wormhole&r lets you access the linked Dimensional storage from other places.
Sneak right-click the Actuator with the Wormhole to bind it, then place it anywhere. Opening the Wormhole will show the Actuator's contents!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest18F: The &bStorage Accessor&r allows access to a dimensional storage from anywhere!
Sneak right-click the Actuator with the Accessor to bind it, and then use the Accessor anywhere to access the contents.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest1AD: By throwing &aDemon Dream Fruit&r on the ground, and lighting it on fire, it will create &bSpirit Fire&r.
&bSpirit Fire&r has magical properties that can convert items thrown on it into other items.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest1B6: Soultained and hallowed ingots can be used to make rings and other equipment.
These trinkets range from simple boosts to toughness and armor, to enhancing critical strikes and healing when collecting spirits.
See individual trinkets within the Encyclopedia Arcana.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest1CA: &2Wilden&r are magical creatures found in the overworld within &2Wilden Dens&r. However, these can be difficult to find at times.

Instead, you can summon the different types by using a &3Summon Wilden Ritual&r. This can be used to get your first Wilden Drops, which are needed for several recipes, including upgrading to a &dTier 3 Spell Book&r.
The &dRitual of Summon Wilden&r can be augmented to summon the boss of Ars Nouveau: The &5Wilden Chimera&r.

To summon this boss, you'll need to first use a &2Tablet of Summon Wilden&r on a Ritual Brazier. Before you active the ritual, augment it by using 1 of each of the Wilden mob drops: 1 Wing, 1 Horn, and 1 Spike. Now you can activate the ritual with an empty hand, and summon in the Wilden Chimera!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest1CC: This pack has 4 custom Pentacles that mark different stages of your &6Realms&f progression:
&aRite of Hel's Dominion&r: Used in &6Helheim&r and beyond to summon Foliot Spirits and other items.
&bRite of Jormungandr's Coil&r: Used in &6Niflheim&r and beyond to summon Djinni Spirits and other items.
&cRite of Surtr's Crucible&r: Used in &6Muspelheim&r and beyond to summon Foliot Spirits and other items.
&dRite of Freyr's Luminous Pact&r: Used in &6Alfheim&r and beyond to summon Foliot Spirits and other items.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest1FE: With Magebloom, we can craft &aSpell Parchment&r for us to inscribe our spells on!

To inscribe a spell onto a &aBlank Parchment&r, use the parchment on your &aScribe's Table&r. Select the spell you'd like to inscribe in your Spell Book, then sneak-right click onto the parchment to set the spell!
These &aBlank Parchments&r can also be used to create item filters to help with automation, as well as making &dWarp Scrolls&r!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest20C: &bDimensional Stabilizers&r allow you to increase the max capacity of your Dimensional Storage.
They have to be placed 2-5 blocks away, and have to aim at the floating Matrix above the base. More than one can be installed.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest21D: If you're into magic and exploration, you are bound to run into a &dSpell Scroll&r from &eIron's Spells 'n Spellbooks&r. This is an amazing magic mod that adds a ton of spells for you to play with.
Unless you find a &aSpell Book&r as loot, you can start by making a &aFlimsy Journal&r to hold a few spells.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest270: With the &eRitual Diviner&r, you can Sneak-Left or Sneak-Right click air to choose a &3Ritual&r, then use it on the &2Master Ritual Stone&r to place and color the &aRitual Stones&r for the seclected &3Ritual&r.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest279: If you throw &aSoul Snares&r at mobs, they have a chance of getting white particles. Killing them will drop &bDemon Will&r.
&bDemon Will&r drops from snared mobs which will have random will quality.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest28F: If you want to infuse your weapons, armor, and spell books with even more power, one of the best options is crafting some &3Upgrade Orbs&r.
These Orbs are created by combining an &aEmpty Upgrade Orb&r with a 8 &3Runes&r.
To add the Upgrade Orb to your equipment, use the &dArcane Anvil&r. Up to 3 Orbs can be applied per equipment piece.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest292: You'll gain access to the materials needed to make the purple chalk after reaching &6Muspelheim&f.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest30C: &aBlank Slate&r are some of the most basic ingredients in the mod. Just place Stone in a &cBlood Altar&r with at least &b1,000 LP&r in it.
If you insert 2 Stone, it'll try to craft both at the same time. If you don't have enough &bLP&r, the craft will fail.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest334: The &dAlchemist Cauldron&r is an upgrade to your regular old brewing stand.
This Cauldron can be used to brew potions, and is also used to break down &bSpell Scrolls&r for a chance to recycle the &bInk&r used to create it.
This is also the main way to regularly obtain &cBlood Vials&r. Just supply a body inside of the Cauldron!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest349: By inserting a common source of fuel into this device, a nearby cruicble's focusing process will be accelerated. This comes at a cost of additional damage risk to the focal Impetus, ultimately wearing it out faster than normal and producing less material overall in its lifespan.

Speed isn't the only thing that can be changed with a Spirit Cruicible. Through the Spirit Altar, further modifications can be created. Up to four can be set into the Spirit Crucible itself, and linked Catalyzers can take one each.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest34E: It's that magical table we were talking about!
Once crafted, you can place this down to research and craft new &bGlyphs&r, which are the base for spell crafting, as they teach you new parts for your &dSpells&r.
Let's learn how to craft a &bGlyph&r!
&bGlyphs&r are also tiered. With a &aNovice Spell Book&r, you'll only be able to cast &aTier 1 Glyphs&r. To cast higher tier spells, you'll need to upgrade your Spell Book.
To craft a &bGlyph&r, you'll need to right click on the Scribe's Table with your Spell Book in hand. This will open up the &bGlyph&r menu!
&oNote: Break spell has been disabled for this pack.&r
This will show you every &bGlyph&r you can make, including those you have already learned. On the right side, you can filter them by tier, or search for a specific one.
For our first &bGlyph&r, let's make &aAmplify&r! Search for it, then click it to see what items you need at the bottom, then click the "Select" button.
Now you can close out of the menu and right click the table with the required items, and watch the magic happen!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest409: Knowledge is part of the soul, and though we tend to lose our experiences we die, apparently the earth can claim some of it.
This Brilliance can be smelted down into a bland shimmering mass to be consumed and gain its experience, or fashioned into a couple of other useful items.
It seems like Brilliance has some more utility not yet known...best to keep some for later.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest41E: The &aHellfire Forge&r uses &bWill&r to craft items.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest43B: The &bDominion Wand&r is the wrench of Ars Nouveau, and has several important uses!

First, this wand can be used to configure the transfer of &dSource&r between blocks. For example, you can use this to direct the flow of Source from a &aSource Relay&r into a specific &bSource Jar&r. Just use the wand on the block you'd like to take Source from, then use it again on the block you'd like to transfer it to.
You can clear the selection by sneak-using the wand. Sneak-using the wand in the air willd switch it to Strict mode, allowing you to specify the exact side you want to use.
This is also used to help control Familiars!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest454: No matter what kind of spell school you choose to use, there is an armor set just for you.
To make these, you'll need to make &dArcane Cloth&r first. Combine several pieces of the cloth with a &aRune&r, and you can make some of the strongest mage armor!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest45E: Within the depths of &6Niflheim&f, you'll find the &bWeeping Well&r.
Items thrown inside it will convert into new items entirely.
Falling inside it may have... consequences...
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest48D: Throughout your adventures, you'll run into plenty of &dArcane&r loot.
The most common item you'll find is &dArcane Essence&r. This can be used to create &dArcane Cloth&r, brew &bMana Potions&r, and more!

You'll also find &aBlank Runestones&r, which can be used to craft &2Runestones&r that create some of the most powerful gear in the mod. &aNon-blank Runestones&r can also be found after killing wizards.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest4A9: &dArcane Essence&r can be useful in making your first magic armor set.
When combined with a piece of leather armor, it creats a piece of the &aWandering Magician Set&r.
This is an early game armor, but can be great when you need extra mana to cast better spells!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest4B1: The &3Edge of the Hidden Realm Ritual&r will send you to a &6Dungeon Dimension&r made of 4 rooms, unlocked with &aIron Keys&r.
Using the same &aInversion Pillar&r will always send you to the same dungeon. You have to redo the &3Ritual&r to create a new one.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest4C7: The &dEnchanting Apparatus&r is basically the ritual table of Ars. It uses nearby items placed on &aArcane Pedestals&r to create new items, make enchantments, or upgrade Mage Armor later on.

To function, the Apparatus needs an &3Arcane Core&r placed underneath it. It also needs several &aArcane Pedestals&r placed within 3 blocks from the Apparatus. The number of pedestals needed depends on the recipe!
Some recipes also require &dSource&r, which means you'll need &aSource Jars&r placed within 3 blocks as well.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest4F3: Brooches can be crafted that allow you to equip Runes containing powerful upgrades at a cost.
The Runic Workbench forms runes by first inserting the tablet to inscribe, then applying the required amount of spirt.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest4F9: A lot of blocks and recipes require Source to function, which means we'll need both a way to store it, and a way to generate it.
To generate Source, you'll need to use a &aSourcelink&r. There are many different types, each with their own ways of drawing out Source from their environments.
Storing Source is easy! Placing a &aSource Jar&r near any Sourcelink and it will slowly fill up over time. You can also use &aRelays&r to transfer Source between blocks!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest510: &aBlood Orbs&r give you a pool of &bLP&r, called a Soul Network, which is used to power &3Rituals&r and &dSigils&r.
The &aWeak Blood Orb&r is the first and smallest orb, holding &b5,000 LP&r. It can be bound to a player and filled with blod by right-clicking. You can also fill it in the &cBlood Altar&r.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest575: &dSource Gems&r are needed to create &aSourcestone&r. On top of being a great decorative block, this is another important crafting material you'll need!
We'll use a few of these to craft several &aArcane Pedestals&r. These are used in several recipes for both the &dEnchanting Apparatus&r and the &aImbuement Chamber&r.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest60B: &7Arcane Ashes&r are used for &bAlchemy Arrays&r, which craft items or perform other functions.
&dSigils&r use &bLP&r to perform a variety of functions and tasks.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest61C: Once you get your hands on some &bInk&r, you can use this to craft new spell scrolls using the &dSpell Forge&r.
For each scroll, you'll need some Ink, paper, and a specific item that determines the &bSpell school&r you wish to craft. You can use JEI to see all of the items for each school!
The tier of &bInk&r used determines the level of the spell you can craft. Certain spells can only be crafted with higher inks.
Pro Tip: Trading with Piglins is an easy way to get &dCrying Obsidian&r.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest61F: Within the Nether, you might run into an &cAncient Battleground&r.
Across the battlefield, you might see &cPiles of Armor Scraps&r. Mining these piles might seem tempting, but might disturb the &dAncient Knights&r that wore this armor.
Defeating one is necessary for progression, as these drop &cCinder Essence&r.
Also of note is &eHoglins&r of the crimson forests dropping the appropriately named &cHogskin&r, which is required for some improved spellbook crafts.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest621: You'll gain access to the materials needed to make the golden chalk after reaching &6Niflheim&f.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest623: The rewards from this quest have special attributes:
- &aSacrificial Knife&r: +2 Self Sacrifice Bonus and +2 Healing received
- &aDagger of Sacrifice&r: +2 Sacrifice Bonus and 25%% Life Steal
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest66D: The &aArcane Anvil&r will quickly become your best friend when using this mod.
This anvil can be used to &bupgrade spells, equipment,&r and even &bimbue spells onto your gear!&r.
Have a favorite spell but it's rather weak? Upgrade it using higher tier inks using the &aArcane Anvil&r!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest675: &dThe Unchained Rite&f requires all 5 rune slots filled with Arcane Spirits.
It turns the totem into Soulwood and converts nearby blocks into blighted blocks.
Soulwood Totem rites have different effects and continuously corrupt the nearby area.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest680: &dBinding Reagent&r is used to make &6Living Armor&r, an incredibly powerful armor set that upgrades itself as you use it.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest689: Even magical tools and armor take wear and tear and eventually need to be either replaced or repaired. This pylon handles the latter.

While it can only function on certain items that are either fully mundane or in tune with soul energies, it would seem spirits observe the right of choice to repair one's cherished belongings rather than needing to destroy or discard in favor of the new.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest6A3: Totemic Rites work by engraving runes into Runewood Logs stacked above a Runewood Totem Base.
- Affect blocks in a 5×5 area beneath the base, in the direction the runes face
Two identical rites' ranges cannot overlap, cancelling the first one.
Right-clicking the base with a Totemic Staff will highlight the area of effect for each totem, and can also toggle individual runes into an active visual state for decoration.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest6AB: The &aAlchemy Table&r uses &bLP&r from an orb linked to your soul network to craft items.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest6DD: The &cBlood Altar&r can be upgraded into 5 tiers, by placing certain &aRunes&r and blocks around it.
The second tier requires 8 &aRunes&r placed in a circle around it, one block below. &aRunes&r double as &cAltar&r upgrades, changing their functionality in some way.
Higher tiers are required for certain crafting recipes. See the &bSanguine Scientem&r for a full guide on each tier.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest706: If you want to transfer Source around your world, you'll need to make &bSource Relays&r.
Using the &bDominion Wand&r, you can tell the Relays to pull from specific Source Jars and transport the Source into either other Source Relays, or other Source Jars for storage.
To pull Source from Source Jars, first right click on the jar with the Dominion Wand, and then right click on the next Jar or Relay you want to transport it to. Relays only work up to 30 blocks away!
To clear the connections, sneak-use the Wand on the Relay you want to reset.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest70A: To prove your mastery in the art of magic, you'll need to create &6Marks of Mastery&r.

These are created in the Enchanting Apparatus by enchanting the &dWilden Tribute&r with each type of essence. You'll get 5 per craft, which can be used to upgrade your mage armor to the highest tier! These are also used to upgrade a &6Lesser Spell Focus&r.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest70C: &3Tartaric Gems&r will absorb and store &bDemon Will&r as it is picked up.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest726: We can also inscribe spells directly onto &dMagical Equipment&r!
Depending on the equipment, this can be used to use more than the default of 10 spell slots for a spell. Because we all need more augments, right?
Spells that are created to be inscribed onto equipment must not have a &2Form&r. Each piece of equipment will cast a specific form by default, freeing up that spell slot for you to use!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest760: Hallowed Gold can be infused after obtaining gold from post-&6Helheim Realms&f.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest787: Spells can be cast by equipping your &aSpell Book&r in its curio slot.
Once equipped, you can open up the scroll wheel using the &bR&r keybind by default. Casting the selected spell can be done by pressing &bV&r.
These can all be changed in your keybinds. Try searching for &acategory:"Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks - General"&r.
There are also quick cast options!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest790: Using the Enchantment Apparatus, we can make &dMagebloom Seeds&r for all of our fabric needs.
When harvested, &bMagebloom&r can be turned into &bMagebloom Fiber&r. This Fiber can be used to make several things, but most importantly, &dMagical Armor&r!

There are 3 different types of base armor, each having unique thread slots per armor piece. For example, making the Battlemage set from diamond armor gives the best defence, but has lower tier thread slots per upgrade.
You can learn more by reading each one in the next set of quests!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest7C8: A major part of &eOccultism's &bRituals&r involve drawing circles using different colored chalks. These circles are called &aPentacles&r.
Different &bRituals&r have different patterns that must be drawn on the ground, which can be found within the &eDictionary of Spirits&r.
Drawm chalk takes a long time to break, unless you use a &bChalk Brush&r.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest7CF: Speeds up the Spirit Altar when in range
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest7F6: We can't really be that magical until we get mage gear, and the &3Alteration Table&r is used to make the gear even better!

Each piece of mage gear comes with at least one &aThread Slot&r. The Tier of that slot depends on the piece of armor, which is shown in the item's tooltip. Threads add special effects to armor, and to add threads, we're going to need that table.

Threads can be crafted and then inscribed onto armor using the &3Alteration Table&r. To use it, place the armor you'd like to alter onto the stand on the table. The tablet on the table will then show you the available Thread Slots it has, and you can right click a Thread on the tablet to add it to the armor. Now you can just remove your armor!
If you want to remove a thread, place the armor onto the table and interact with the display with an empty hand.
If you want to upgrade the tier of your mage gear for more thread slots, you can use the &dEnchantment Apparatus&r.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest7F9: You'll gain access to the materials needed to make the golden chalk after reaching &6Alfheim&f.
This is the final-tier chalk in this version of Occultism, allowing you to summon and bind &3Marid&f spirits.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest990: &3Rituals&r use &bLP&r from your Soul Network to perform various tasks such as: generating ores, growing crops, damaging mobs for &bLP&r, and many more.

&3Rituals&r are centered around the &2Master Ritual Stone&r, with a number of &aRitual Stones&r placed nearby, using a &eRitual Diviner&r to place them will automatically inscribe them with the correct runes. Finally, activate it by right-clicking the &2Master Ritual Stone&r with an &bActivation Crystal&r.
is required to place the ritual structures
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.quest993: If you're very new to occultism or looking to use &eOccultism&f as one of your main mods for storage, automation, and more, then it is advised that you follow the &bDictionary of Spirits&r.
While there may be some progression changes, this modonomicon guide contains more information than you'll ever need.
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.questE6D: Lesser Spell Slot Improvements can be crafted from a lot of &cHogskin&r and some &bArcane Cloth.&r
They can be repeatedly applied to any &aSpellbook&r via the &aArcane Anvil&r to grant up to a max of 12 spell slots, even for the Flimsy Journal!
ftbquests.chapter.general_magic.title: Mimir's Wisdom
ftbquests.chapter.general_storage.quest1: To make any of the upgrades for your backpack, you'll first need to craft an &aUpgrade Base&r.

There are a ton of useful upgrades you can make, like &aStack Upgrades&r to increase the slot stack limit for storing tons of items, or the &aFeeding Upgrade&r that can automatically feed you when you are hungry!
Make sure to check them all out in JEI!
&fUpgrade Base
These &dProcessors&r are the main crafting components needed for most of the network components you'll use, like &aTerminals&r, &eDisk Drives&r, and many more.
It is worth automating the production of these as soon as possible, but keep in mind different machines may be more efficient depending on your progression path.
Any #ae2:processors
The &aLinking Tool&r is more commonly used to link drawers to a &3Storage Controller&r.
To link a drawer, first Sneak + Right-click it on a &3Controller&f, then on the drawer you wish to add to that Controller's network.
You'll also see the range that the Controller can reach when you hover over it with the tool in hand. This can be upgraded with Storage Upgrades!

While looking into the air, using the tool will switch between adding or removing drawers. If you Sneak + Right-click the tool in the air, it will switch between adding a single drawer at a time, or multiple!
&fLinking Drawers
These are all the blocks you'll need to complete a typical high-end &dAssembler Matrix&r setup.
&7&oThis block count builds a 7x7x7 structure.
150x Assembler Wall/Glass
&6Max Size Assembler Matrix
&dConduits&f are highly configurable and can occupy the same block space as other &dConduit&f types.
You can configure them is using the &aYeta Wrench&f, and, if &dConduits&f are hidden beneath a &aFacade&f, holding the wrench will uncover them for easy configuration.
&eEnderIO
&eEnder Storage&r allows for cross-dimensional storage of items and fluids.
&aEnder Chests&r link their inventories to others with matching color patterns. You can use any colored dye on the wool pads to change its color.
&3Ender Tanks&r work in the same way as &aEnder Chests&r but store liquids instead of items.
&7&oUnlocked after reaching &6Musplheim&7.
&2Ender Pouches&r allow you to remotely access an &aEnder Chest&r of the same color pattern. Right-clicking the pouch on any &aEnder Chest&r will change the pouch's color to match that of the chest.
Using a &bDiamond&r on the latch of an &aEnder Chest&r will move it to a seperate private network for the player that used the diamond. This is especially good for server use.
&eEnder Storage
ftbquests.chapter.general_storage.quest2: After you have formed the &dQuantum Bridge&r multiblock for your base, you can craft and link the &6Quantum Bridge Card&r to install in your Wireless Terminal! This card allows you to access your network from any dimension wirelessly.

To link the two, you'll need to create a pair of &dQuantum Entangled Singularities&r, and place one into a &6Quantum Network Bridge&r and the other into your &dWireless Terminal&r, along with the card itself.
To teach your system how to craft items, you'll need to provide it with &aCrafting Patterns&r. These are created inside of a &dPattern Encoding Terminal&r.
By providing the terminal with &aBlank Patterns&r, you can use &eJEI&r to search for an item you want to make a pattern for, then clicking the &b+&r to add the recipe onto the terminal.
Once the pattern is on the table, you can click the button below the &aBlank Pattern&r to encode the recipe onto the pattern to be used in autocrafting!
Channels are set to infinite in this pack!
Without needing to worry about them, you can simply connect different parts of your network using whichever ME Cables you want.
The &aCrafting Grid&r allows you to access all connected inventories and craft with them at one central location.
Just like other Panels, these cannot connect to &3Dense Cables&r. Glass, Covered, or Smart Cables will work!
ftbquests.chapter.general_storage.quest3: You can increase the overall storage size of a backpack by upgrading it to the next tier!
From the basic backpack, you can upgrade to either &aCopper&r or &aIron&r. Upgrading to Copper first allows you to save iron, as you only need 4 Iron Ingots to upgrade from Copper.
Each tier also allows for more &aUpgrade Slots&r!
Tier Upgrades!
&fTier Upgrades
&aStack Upgrades&r multiply the stack size of each slot in a backpack. These are super useful for storing tons of the same types of items!
When combined with other upgrades like &aTank&r or &aBattery&r upgrades, these also increase the overall storage limit of those upgrades as well.
&fStack Upgrades
&fStack Upgrades
One of the main uses of digital storage is the ability to &3Autocraft Items&r.
In &eAE2&r, this is done by creating custom multiblocks that make use of &aCrafting CPUs, Co-Processors&r, and more.
To get started, you'll need to make the main crafting component: the &3Crafting Unit&r.
&eNote&r: Autocrafting is only unlocked after progressing the &6Muspelheim&f questline.
&3Autocrafting
&eSophisticated Storage&r allows you to create and upgrade your chests, barrels, and more!
These &eSophisticated Storages&r can hold even more items, hold fluids, or even automate certain tasks like smelting down ores.
To start out, you can craft a &aSophisticated Chest&r or &aSophisticated Barrel&r by combining the vanilla item with a redstone torch.
If you've already placed down your storage in the world, you can craft the &aBasic Tier Upgrade&r and use it on the storage to upgrade it.
Any #sophisticatedstorage:base_tier_wooden_storage
&eSophisticated Storage
&eAE2&r has its own power unit called &bAE&r, which, does not accept power directly from other sources. An &aEnergy Acceptor&r will convert FE into AE power for your network.
If you start running out of power as you add more machines to your network, it might help to create an energy buffer using &bEnergy Cells&r, which store power for future use.
You can also generate free power using the &dCrystal Resonance Generator&r, which generates 20 AE/t. You may only have one of these per network.
Powering your system
The &dCrafting CPU Multiblock&r is the heart of autocrafting within &eAE2&r. These multiblocks must be built as rectangular prisms containing at least one &aCrafting Storage&r.
&aCrafting Storages&r will determine how many items you can request to be autocrafted at once.
The &dCrafting Co-Processor&r is an optional recommended block. Each Co-Processor allows one more sub tasks to be queued at once, and speeds up complex autocrafting operations.
For more information, refer to the &eAE2&r Guide.
Any #ae2:crafting_storages
&fThe &dAutocrafting Multiblock
To get started with &eApplied Energistics 2&r, you'll want to mine certus quartz from &bBudding Certus Blocks&r in &6Jotunheim&f, or very rarely from &dBudding Enderslime&f in &6Helheim&f.
&eNote&r: Squat grow works on budding blocks.
Digital Storage
ftbquests.chapter.general_storage.quest4: &eIntegrated Dynamics&f has an incredibly powerful and consutomizable logistics system capable of handling items, fluids, and energy, even across dimensions.
Check its GuideMe page for more details.
&7&oAccessible after obtaining &bAlchemy Arrays
&eIntegrated Dynamics
This chapter covers most of the basic ways to store and manage your items!
&aStorage and Logistics
Just like Ender Chests, &dEnder Drawers&r will store items that can be accessed across dimensions.
To do this, you'll need 2 &dEnder Drawers&r linked together using the &3Linking Tool&r.
Left click the &3Linking Tool&r on the top of the first &dEnder Drawer&r to grab its frequency, then Sneak + Right-click the on the second drawer to set the matching frequency.
&7&oUnlocked after reaching &6Niflheim&7 or &6Jotunheim&7.
&dEnder Drawers
&eFunctional Drawers&r is a storage mod that aims to provide an easy solution to storing tons of items in a single block!
To place an item in, simply Right-click on the drawer with the item. Double Right-clicking will deposit multiple stacks at a time.
To remove items from a drawer, the same behaviour applies using Left-click instead.
Don't like the look of Drawers? Make &aFramed Drawers&r instead!
These drawers can be crafted together with other items to change the look of the drawer to your liking. Each slot in the crafting table corresponds to a specific texture on the drawer.
- 1st Slot: Outside Texture
- 2nd Slot: Inside Texture
- 3rd Slot: Framed Drawer
- 4th Slot: Divider Texture
Fluid Drawers
&aItem Drawers
&eFunctional Drawers
&eEntangled&r allows you to bind two blocks together, allowing you to interact with them as if they were the same block!
This allows you to transfer items, energy, fluids, and more instantly.
Useful for hiding your messy cables.
&7&oUnlocked after reaching &6Niflheim&7 or &6Jotunheim&7.
&eEntangled &fBlocks
The &dAssembler Matrix&r is a multiblock structure that combines the functionality of &aMolecular Assemblers&r and &2Pattern Providers&r, and it can run many crafting jobs simultaneously.
The &aAssembler Matrix&r can be between 3x3x4 and 7x7x7, must contain at least &b1 Matrix Pattern Core&r and &b1 Matrix Craft Core&r. It must &cnot&f contain any hollow spaces.
- The edges must be &bAssembler Matrix Frames&r
- The interior must be &dMatrix Cores&r
- The faces can be &aAssembler Matrix Wall&r/&2Glass&r
The &dAssembler Matrix
ftbquests.chapter.general_storage.quest5: If you want to store items non-digitally, you can attach a storage bus to an inventory. This will allow your network to read the contents of that inventory.
&6LaserIO&r allows you to transfer pretty much everything using LASERS!

To get started, you'll need some &aLaser Nodes&r and a &cLaser Wrench&r to connect them. These are the main blocks of the mod, which allows lasers to directly interact with blocks they are attached to.
To set up how they will interact with the block, you'll need to install &aCards&r to specify what you'd like them to do.
These cards are highly configurable. For example, &aItem Cards&r can be used to pull or push items from separate inventories, and can be filtered for precise automation.

When opening up the interface for a &aLaser Node&r, you'll have a tab for every face of the node. This determines the side that the Card works on. Think of the Card as essentially the "settings file" for that face.

The cards can also be upgraded to increase the speed at which it interacts with other blocks, allowing for extremely fast speeds for automation. They can also be filtered and set to specific channels.
You're not always going to have straight lasers from each &aLaser Node&r. That's where &aLaser Connectors&r come in!
&eLaserIO
&aCollector Upgrade&r - Adds an internal magnet to pick items up off the ground around it.
&aPuller Upgrade&r - Allows the drawer to pull from adjacent inventories.
&aPusher Upgrade&r - Allows the drawer to push to adjacent inventories.
&dVoid Upgrade&r - Voids items above the current stack limit.
These can be configured by right clicking the upgrade while inside of the drawer.
&aUtility Upgrades
&aItem Interfaces&f can be connected to any inventory attached by &2Logic Cabels&f to an &bIntegrated Dynamics Network&f.

Doing this allows stored items to be accessed by other network components such as the &dStorage Terminal&f, which allows you to view those items and even craft with them using the built-in crafting table.
Integrated Storage
You'll want to craft a &aBackpack&f to give yourself more player inventoryt if you plan to explore the vast Nordic Realms.
These tiered &aBackpacks&r also have tons of cool upgrades to help you in your adventures. You can place them in a curio slot as well for easy access by pressing 'B' .
&aBackpacks&r can also be dyed and placed down by sneak-right clicking while in your main hand.
&eSophisticated Backpacks
&aTranslocators&f are an early but effective method of transfering items and fluids between 2 blocks.
&aTranslocators
&aLimited Barrels&r function like Drawers from &eFunctional Storage&r.

These &2Barrels&r can only hold up to 4 types of items, but will hold several stacks of each. The amount of item types it can hold depends on the type of &aLimited Barrel&r you craft, with I holding a single item type, and IV holding 4 item types.
Limited Barrels
&aLimited Barrels
By default, drawers can only hold a base amount of items depending on their size. You can upgrade this with these upgrades!

For example, a standard Drawer that holds one type of item can hold up to around &a2,000 items&r for the base amount. Each upgrade multiplies the total storage amount, meaning the upgrades stack. Most drawers can hold 4 &aInventory Size Upgrades&r of any tier.
Pro Tip: You can also place these inside of a &3Storage Controller&r to increase the linking range.
&bSize Upgrades
ftbquests.chapter.general_storage.quest6: Once you've encoded some patterns using the &dPattern Encoding Terminal&r, you can place them into a &aPattern Provider&r. The &aProviders&r will try to complete the craft using whatever block it is attached to.

For doing shaped and shapeless craft recipes that don't require machines, you can place the &aProvider&r next to a &3Molecular Assembler&r. For other autocrafting tasks that require some type of processing, place the &aProvider&r facing the machine you want to craft in.
&aPattern Providers&r can also be renamed by using a &cCutting Knife&r on them, which can help you find them easier in your Pattern Terminals!
For more information, refer to the &eAE2&r Guide.
Storing Patterns
The &dQuantum Network Bridge&r allows you to connect machines and storages far from your base to your AE2 network.
To make this, you'll need to build 2 identical multiblock structures: one connected to your main network, and one connected to the new place you want to build in.

Each multiblock will consist of &b8 Quantum Rings&r with an &6ME Quantum Link Chamber&r in the center. To connect the two, you'll need to craft and use a &dQuantum Entangled Singularity&r on each of the Link Chambers to connect them.
&eNote&r: Both sides will need to be chunk loaded to work.
Instead of storing Iron Nuggets, Ingots, and Blocks in 3 separate drawers, you can store them all in a &aCompacting Drawer&r.
These are special drawers that store and convert items directly into their compressed versions. This is useful for items like Iron or Gold to easily convert back and forth!
With &aSimple Compacting Drawers&r, you can store items that only use a base and block recipe. This is great for items like Redstone, Diamonds, and Emeralds!
&fCompacting Drawers
&fCompacting Drawers
&aImport&r and &aExport Buses&r allow you to pipe items in and out of your system and any other connected inventories.
This, along with interfaces and pattern providers, will allow you to fully automate your entire base.
These devices can be upgraded with &aCards&r to be redstone sensitive, accept NBT specific items or not (Fuzzy), or to increase speed and capacity with &eAcceleration&r and &eCapacity Cards&r.
Importing \&\ Exporting
If you're looking to store your items &bDigitally&r, you'll want to make the &aME Drive&r and some &2Storage Cells&r.
The &aME Drive&r can house up to 10 Disks. When connected to your network, items can automatically be stored as digital media and accessed via Interfaces, I/O Buses and Terminals.

There are 2 types of item storage drives. &aItem Storage Cells&r can store 63 different types of items, while &aME DISK Drives&r can store an infinite number of item types, with a higher crafting cost.
Any #ae2:item_storage_cells
Any #ae2things:disk_drives
ftbquests.chapter.general_storage.quest7: Circuits can be made from redstone and silicon. Using &eEnderIO&f, &eThermal&f, or &eEmbers&f.
You'll be required to have progressed into &6Jotunheim&f or &6Muspelheim&f before you can get started with &eAE2&f.
Stamping
Making Processors
Each &dAssembler Matrix Craft Core&r can perform up to 8 crafting jobs simultaneously.
Each &dAssembler Matrix Pattern Core&r provides 36 pattern slots to the &6Assembler Matrix&r.
Each &dAssembler Matrix Speed Core&r counts as an &aAcceleration Card&r for the overall structure.
The &6Assembler Matrix&r will run at full speed with 5 &dSpeed Cores&r. Any more will have no extra effect on its processing speeds.
The &3Matter Condenser&r will destroy any item inserted into it like a trashcan.
Providing it a Cell to act as a buffer, it can convert those items into &aMatter Balls&r(1-16k) or &dSingularities&r (64k+) instead.
These &dSingularities&r are critical for creating massive storages and inter-dimensional links.
To make the &dFluix Crystal&r, you'll first need to charge &bCertus Quartz Crystal&r by hitting them with a lightning spell, or by using Powah's &aEnergizing Orb&f.
Next, toss the crystal with a piece of redstone and nether quartz in a pool of water out in the world. You can throw in many of these at once to speed up the process.
Fluix Creation
If you want to connect and create all of your storage into a single network, this can easily be done by making the &aStorage Controller&r.

Any storage container that is placed next to the &aController&r will automatically link to it. This allows you to item dump by right clicking or sneak-right clicking on the Controller for easy inventory management!
You can make &aStorage Links&r to connect any storage container that might be separate from your main storage hub, and can use the &aStorage Tool&r to link them up to the Controller!
&aCreating Storage Networks
The &aBasic Item Collector&r is configurable collector that automatically collects items within its radius and pushes them into an inventory below.
By default, the &aBasic Item Collector&r can collect items up to an 11x11x11 area. Opening up the interface allows you to adjust the collector area.
Upgrading to an &dAdvanced Item Collector&r allows for more control, giving you options for filtering items it collects, as well as extending the collection range to a max of 15x15x15.
&aSimple Item Collectors
ftbquests.chapter.general_storage.quest9: The &3Configuration Tool&r is used to lock Drawers to only interact with certain items. This is super useful when you are constantly pulling or pushing items from Drawers!
&ePro Tip&r: If you've connected Drawers to a &aStorage Controller&r, you can use the Configuration Tool on the Controller to lock all of the Drawers that are linked, all at once!

You can also Sneak + Right-click the tool in the air to change modes. There are several modes that you can configure for drawers, like hiding the item count or disabling the item render on a Drawer to reduce FPS lag.
ftbquests.chapter.general_storage.questA: &3Storage Controllers&r allow you to connect and interact with several drawers at once.

Once linked to your drawers via the &3Linking Tool&r, you can double Right-click the &3Controller&f to deposit all items from your inventory directly into the drawer network! This also means you can pipe in items into the controller as well.
ftbquests.chapter.general_storage.questB: Inventory management is pretty important, and that's what &ePocket Storage&r is for!
These devices will automatically pickup items that you collect based on what is placed inside of them. Upgrade the tier to store more at once.
&eNote&r: These will automatically void excess items, meaning once you've collected the stack limit, those items will be voided.
ftbquests.chapter.general_storage.questE: You can make a &aWireless Access Point&f and a &dWireless Crafting Terminal&f to access your AE2 system wirelessly.
Installing &bWireless Boosters&r into the access point will extend the range but cost more energy to operate.

The &dWireless Crafting Terminal&r allows you to link to a wireless access point in your network by placing it in the slot in its interface. Once linked, you can access all of your items and even craft on the go anywhere you have signal!
&eNote&f: Make sure you have some way to charge items in your inventory via modded batteries or other wireless methods like Powah and Flux Networks.

ftbquests.chapter.general_tech.quest109C: The &aAlloy Smelter&r will be your most used machine in &eEnderIO&r. Like other &eEnderIO&f machines it can be upgraded with &bCapacitors&r.
ftbquests.chapter.general_tech.quest150A: &dEnder Gates&r are used to transfer power wirelessly.
ftbquests.chapter.general_tech.quest1864: &bIntegral Components&r are crucial to making your Machines more effective.
They scale your &eThermal Expansion&r machine's stats multiplicatively, as shown on their tooltip.
ftbquests.chapter.general_tech.quest1872: The &aInduction Smelter&r is used to combine other materials into alloys.
ftbquests.chapter.general_tech.quest197E: &aBlazing&r and &bNiotic&r tiers can be accessed in &6Niflheim&f and &6Jotunheim&f. &2Blaze Powder&r can be made early by centrifuging magma cream, or by throwing glowstone blocks into Pyrotheum.
&2Spirited&f and &cNitro&f tiers can be accessed in &6Muspelheim&f.
ftbquests.chapter.general_tech.quest1CA4: The &aWrench&r is a multipurpose tool for working with &eCreate&r contraptions.
It can rotate, configure, and dismantle blocks, contraptions, and more!
ftbquests.chapter.general_tech.quest1E6E: The &eDE&r energy core is a tiered energy storage solution capable of storing a near-infinite quantity of power when fully upgraded.
Its core components are the &aEnergy Core&r and the &2Energy Core Stabilizers&r, which can be placed in any direction up to 8 blocks away from the core.
To insert or extract power from the Core, you'll need to place down an &bEnergy Pylon&r within 10 blocks of the core, then place a glass block under or above it.
To upgrade the core, you'll need to surround the &aEnergy Core&r with more &dDraconium Blocks&r per tier. At tier 8, you'll also need to surround it with &6Awakened Draconium Blocks&r.
The energy core has a build guide within its interface when you interact with it that can automatically place the blocks in their position from your inventory.
At tier 8, you will also need to upgrade your &2Stabilizers&r into a ring, requiring a total of 36 blocks (9 per ring).
ftbquests.chapter.general_tech.quest2069: The &aAtomic Reconstructor&r is used to crystalize materials and is one of the main machines used in &eActually Additions&r.
When provided with power, it will shoot a laser beam up to ten blocks away, or until the laser comes into contact with another block.
It will crystalize any dropped items or blocks placed on either side of the laser.
Lenses can be attached to the &aAtomic Reconstructor&f to change its functionality.
ftbquests.chapter.general_tech.quest21DC: This chapter covers tech mods and power generation mods
ftbquests.chapter.general_tech.quest22B2: The &aMechanical Mixer&r is used for recipes, mixing potions, and some other mixing recipes.
The &aBlaze Burner&r is used to generate heat for things like &cSteam Engines&r.
ftbquests.chapter.general_tech.quest283E: The &aEmpowerer&r will consume four surrounding items to empower a central item.
You'll need to set up your &aDisplay Stands&r two blocks away on each side of the &aEmpowerer&r (check the GuideMe page for a diagram).

While there are plenty of other ways to speed up crop growth using other mods, &eMystical Agriculture&r comes with two ways to speed things up, the first one being &aGrowth Accelerators&r.

&aGrowth Accelerators&r work by increasing the crop speed of the plant at the top of the block. These stack up to a certain range depending on the tier. Higher tiers do not increase the growth speed, but instead allow for using more blocks because of the longer range.
For example, having 18 &2Prudentium Growth Accelerators&r provides the same growth speed as using 9 &aInferium Growth Accelerators&r and 9 &2Prudentium Growth Accelerators&r in a single tower.
